scope: Visible Communities directory authorization denial and explicit retry

steps: shared Compose denial and retry surface
NeighborhoodsViewModel retry test on Wasm browser
typed HTTP status propagation compiled at exact Product SHA

assertions: Android, Web and iOS convert real directory HTTP 401 and 403 responses to one portable authorization failure.
Null, connectivity and non-authorization HTTP failures preserve their original transport cause.
The shared directory renders localized denial copy and a stable retry anchor instead of a transport key.
Retry stops the failed collection, starts one replacement collection and clears stale denial state before recovery emits.
The Compose UI test observes the denial message and dispatches exactly one retry on both Wasm and iOS x64.
No authentication requirement, RLS policy, backend data, signing configuration or product permission was changed.

cleanup.mode: no remote fixture or backend mutation used

limitations: The live Supabase policy intentionally keeps the public directory readable, so the deterministic focal proof injects the exact normalized 401/403 transport result rather than changing production RLS to manufacture a denial.
GitHub final jobs retain responsibility for clean-runner integrated certification. Pagination, realtime exhaustiveness and visual pixel parity remain separate Communities scopes.
